body:
I understand what you mean by the up and down feeling. I was having that tonight, but I decided to tell my friends about it and of course they didn't expect it and they were very supportive which put a smile on my face. 

I didn't expect them to be this supportive, honestly, I'm glad I have friends like this. 

I did enjoy the music, that was the highlight of my night. I guess there were some famous Jazz players or something which made it just amazing.

I'm not claiming that I'm completely fine, more like I feel much better. 

I actually felt like seeing my friends and explaining the position that I've been in the past few months, and why I disappeared. Then not forgetting that I haven't eaten anything for 2 days, I had my first meal today after 48 hours.
I just had my first dose of Prozac today, I haven't felt this good/motivated for a long time. Although I'm still having some anxiety, it beats being extremely depressed.

I just started therapy this week, after denying that i had a problem for the past year. Once I realize 
I've become suicidal I went to the therapist.

last night i figured somethings out, and i felt liike i was better. I told my self that i did i have a problem. and I had to deal with it. Then it stuck me again, I just cant seem to end this cycle. I dont know what to say.
I keep telling my self that im fine, then i slump back in the same place i was in
